verdict.rationale: Highnote offers real-time collaborative authorization so developers can approve or decline transactions with their own logic, and spend rules evaluate MCC at authorization time. That implies authorization events carry at least MCC context. However, the evidence never describes the actual contents of an authorization event payload. Missing for 10: documented auth-event fields for merchant name, enhanced merchant data, wallet/token and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-authorization signals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
